notes: Food Code is a categorical identifier for a specific food item. It should be mapped to a Standard Concept in the Observation domain (e.g., a SNOMED or USDA concept for the food). The concept_id is null here because the specific mapping depends on the code value and requires a lookup to a food ontology.
Short Food Code Description is a text label for the food item. It is stored as a string value in the Observation table, linked to the same observation record as the Food Code.
Long Food Code Description is a more detailed text label for the food item. It is stored as a string value in the Observation table, linked to the same observation record as the Food Code.
